verdict.rationale: The developer portal explicitly states that the first-party Anytype CLI can 'run Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting,' which covers the core of the story. A local API, an MCP server and an agents skill that scripts against Anytype data back up the automation surface. missing for 10: detailed CLI/headless setup documentation, explicit CI pipeline guidance or examples (e.g., auth/key provisioning in CI), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless operation.
